/.title: JellyTech | Biotechnology & Life Sciences Club, Acharya Institute
/.description: JellyTech is a student-led, faculty-supervised biotechnology and life-sciences club at Acharya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru: workshops, research engagement and science communication.

/about.title: About JellyTech | Student-led Biotechnology Club
/about.description: A student-led, faculty-supervised, non-commercial co-curricular organization at Acharya Institute of Technology, building exposure, participation, creation and communication in biotechnology.

/programs.title: Programs | JellyTech Workshops, Hackathons & Conferences
/programs.description: Scientific conferences, symposiums, workshops, courses and hackathons coordinated by JellyTech, each one documented so it becomes the foundation for the next.

/media.title: Media | JellyTech Explainers, Podcast & Magazine
/media.description: JellyTech's publishing arm: explainers, news, interviews, a podcast and a magazine, reviewed for scientific accuracy before anything goes out.

/team.title: Team | How JellyTech Is Run
/team.description: Decentralized teams that decide for themselves, with documented handovers so the JellyTech club survives any change in student leadership.

/join.title: Join JellyTech | Apply to the Biotechnology Club
/join.description: JellyTech is a co-curricular club, not a course. Tell us who you are and which side of the work interests you, and we will be in touch when the founding intake opens.

/privacy.title: Privacy | JellyTech
/privacy.description: JellyTech is a non-commercial student club. The site collects the minimum it needs to process a membership application and nothing else.

/terms.title: Terms of Use | JellyTech
/terms.description: This site is published by a student club of Acharya Institute of Technology for informational purposes.
